text: {"label":"Teaching Mands and Requesting","definition":"Procedures for teaching mands, including mands for information, using motivating operations, response modalities such as sign, picture exchange, and speech-generating devices, and promoting mand generalization and variability.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on the mand and its training, unlike general skill acquisition research, broad verbal behavior research, or intraverbal and verbal stimulus control studies."}
